description:
We are a team of curious and passionate learners interested in space, Earth, science, technology, and innovation. We believe that every dataset has a story to tell, and our goal is to turn scientific information into meaningful stories that people can understand and connect with.

We welcome team members who are enthusiastic, creative, and willing to learn. We are particularly interested in connecting with people who have skills or experience in story telling.
summary:
Project Summary – Until We Meet Again, Moon

"Until We Meet Again, Moon" is a creative storytelling project inspired by NASA's three Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicles used during the Apollo 15, 16 and 17 missions.

The story imagines these three rovers unexpectedly meeting on the Moon and sharing their journeys, adventures, technical challenges and contributions to lunar exploration.

By combining historical facts with imaginative storytelling, the project introduces readers to the achievements of the Apollo missions and the important role of the Lunar Roving Vehicles in helping astronauts explore the lunar surface.

The project aims to make space history more engaging, encourage curiosity about space exploration and help readers appreciate the technology behind humanity's first lunar journeys.
details:
Project Details – Until We Meet Again, Moon

Until We Meet Again, Moon is a historical-fiction storytelling project inspired by NASA's Apollo 15, 16 and 17 Lunar Roving Vehicles.

The project presents the history of the three lunar rovers through an imaginative conversation. Each rover shares its mission, experiences, achievements and technical challenges, helping readers understand lunar exploration through storytelling.

The project aims to make space history more interesting and accessible, encourage curiosity about space exploration, and help readers appreciate the technology behind the Apollo missions.

We developed the project through historical research using NASA sources and creative writing. We used Google Docs for writing and organizing the story and Canva for designing and presenting the project. No programming languages or physical hardware were required.

The creative aspect is giving personalities and voices to real historical machines while keeping their experiences and achievements based on historical facts.

During development, we considered historical accuracy, creativity, storytelling structure, readability and reader engagement.
